name: relation
source:
Main character's wife leaves the house without her daughter Misaki. Protagonist does not know how to deal with children, so as a first step he invites Misaki to go shopping. It's a story about strange parent-child relations where sides don't understand each other.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的妻子丢下女儿美咲离家。主人公不知如何应对孩子，第一步便邀请美咲去购物。这是一个彼此无法理解的奇异亲子关系故事。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
